source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Disable NTP function in OS
2. Adjust SUT time to match with a standard time
3. Shutdown the system and unplug all power cords
4. Idle SUT for at least 24 hours
5. Plug power cords and power on the SUT
6. Check SUT time

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. NTP should be disabled successfully
2. SUT time should be adjusted successfully
3. SUT time should be accuracy (The tolerance is within 5 secend)

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- RTC drift after an AC loss/recovery. Agent first disables NTP and reads the RTC via sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "timedatectl set-ntp false 2>&1; hwclock -r 2>&1; date -u 2>&1", then the 24h AC/reboot dwell (operator part for AC) elapses and the agent re-reads to compute drift. The ac_lost dwell is the long-running/operator step.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL RTC (`hwclock -r`) vs system UTC (`date -u`) timestamps at start and after the dwell so the user computes the drift (<=1.73s/day tolerance).
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: disabling NTP + comparing RTC is a state change; restore NTP after the dwell, and the AC-cycle portion is a physical operator action.

original_test_intent: Measure clock accuracy within five seconds after the powered-off SUT has all AC power cords physically unplugged for at least 24 hours and is then reconnected and booted.
original_method: Approved automation handles clock setup and evidence; a qualified operator shuts down, physically identifies and removes every power cord, maintains the AC-loss dwell, reconnects cords and powers on before final clock measurement and synchronization restoration.
manual_activity: Physical removal and reconnection of all power cords is the defining AC-loss stimulus and must be performed and recorded by a qualified operator. Software/PDU/BMC power actions cannot be assumed equivalent.
required_inputs: Reference clock, timezone, RTC mode and signed drift calculation
Complete PSU cord/PDU/shared-feed map and verification of all-AC-loss state
Approved shutdown, unplug, reconnect and power-on SOP
NTP/time backup and restoration, 24-hour timing and recovery
Qualified operator, maintenance window and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Never unplug an unidentified or shared production feed; verify SUT and PSU scope before touch.
Complete approved shutdown and active-workload checks before cord removal.
Preserve BMC/host/clock baselines and stop on unexpected redundancy, boot or management behavior.
Do not replace physical unplugging with PDU/BMC/software action and do not automatically retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect and restore NTP/time configuration and capture RTC/OS/BMC/reference timestamps around operator actions.
Verify dwell timing, calculate drift against the source five-second rule and organize power/boot/log evidence.
Do not claim physical cord work or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve cord map, clock semantics and recovery.
Perform and document all cord removals/reconnections and physical power-on.
Review drift and recovery evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Clock commands are relevant after validation, but its 1.73-second comparison changes the source five-second acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain source physical AC loss and use validated timedatectl/hwclock/date only as the automatable supporting workflow.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All cords unplugged, at least 24 hours, NTP/reference setup, five-second tolerance and 10/1440-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN PHYSICAL ALL-CORD AC LOSS WITH CORRELATED CLOCK EVIDENCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed cord-custody checklist, synchronized reference/RTC/OS/BMC timestamps, proof of the full AC-loss interval and controlled recovery/restoration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact PSU/feed topology and target OS/BMC clock stack.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record PSU, BMC, BIOS, OS, systemd and util-linux versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner power topology/SOP and timekeeping policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traceable cord identity, clock domains and recovery without substituting the physical stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; all physical feeds must remain disconnected for the full dwell.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Cord map, reference/modes, timing and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Loss of BMC power during dwell is expected on some designs, so external timestamps must be authoritative.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a different dwell or stricter tolerance and report that plan, but cannot claim source completion if all cords were not physically removed or the five-second rule was not applied without an explicit override.
expected_evidence: Approved cord map/SOP, reference/time/RTC/NTP policy, dwell and authorization
Pre-loss timestamps and shutdown evidence plus physical removal/reconnection records for every cord
Externally established at-least-24-hour AC-loss duration, boot evidence and post-recovery drift calculation
NTP restoration, final power/host health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires all-cord AC loss and a five-second tolerance. The 1.73-second value occurs only in historical review output.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Cord mapping and time semantics can be supplied; the defined physical method is executable by an operator, so this is MANUAL ONLY rather than blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keep its supporting clock tools but correct the tolerance and classify MANUAL ONLY because physical unplugging is the core stimulus.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retain its power-map/safety controls while changing classification under locked V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Applies this row's explicit physical requirement independently, without generalizing ED-32 to other AC-cycle cases.

review_improvement: Separates the operator-owned all-cord AC-loss proof from automatable clock measurement and rejects both tolerance drift and software power substitution.
independent_technical_reasoning: This source does not merely need an environment prepared once; it explicitly tests clock retention across a human physical unplug/replug interval. Because that action is the core stimulus, the case is MANUAL ONLY even though clock collection is automatable.
